subject: ENGLISH
title: Read the Picture Graph · M01 D20
objective: Interpret a pictograph using its title, categories, symbols, and key.
introduction: A pictograph uses symbols to represent data. Always read the key before counting values. Explore examples, sort cards, practice, and answer five questions.

vocabulary.definition: The name of a book, story, or lesson.
An image or drawing that shows something.
A graph that uses pictures to show numbers.

options.text: A pictograph uses symbols to represent data. Always read the key before counting values.
